review: Each stage gives one mechanic its own colour and Gauntlet combines all of them, so the structure is sound. The curve is not. First Steps kills 29 of 100 ghosts at its first spike patch, which is too hard for a tutorial. Saw Mill is the hardest stage at position 3: it has many saws in the air, their paths are not shown, and the mid player dies with no warning. Spring Loaded tests saws in flight before it teaches a safe bounce. Laser Gate is the best lesson because the dotted beams show the danger early. Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge are fair but have few hazards.
best: Laser Gate shows each beam with a dotted line before it fires, so each death is readable.
worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3 with saw paths that the player cannot read.
